schema: S02-P004 Phase A blind inventory v1
method: Static inspection only. WAR extracted with tar.exe into reviewer scratch; 594 classes parsed by own class-file parser (constant pool, annotations, per-method string constants and invoked methods; no decompilation, so branch order/conditions inside methods are inferred); XML/JSP/properties read directly (XML comments and JSP comments stripped before mechanical enumeration). No runtime, no Stage 1 record, no prior review opened.
evidenceNotation: WAR:<entry>:<line> = line in the shipped file inside the WAR (stable); class:<fqcn>#<method> = bytecode symbol (no line numbers because derived); legacy/<file>:<line> = file in the legacy folder; bd:<file> = exhaustive breakdown in phase-a-breakdown/.

statusVocabulary.confirmed-static: directly shown by shipped configuration/markup/bytecode symbols
statusVocabulary.inferred: reasoned from partial static evidence (e.g. call present but order/condition not visible, or framework default behaviour)
statusVocabulary.not-active: present in the package but commented out, not loaded or not wired
statusVocabulary.broken-inferred: wired, but a referenced class/resource/property is missing, so failure at runtime is expected; not observed

runtimeNote: Nothing in this inventory was observed live; every behavioural item remains runtime-unverified (Stage 3).
negativeSearchControls: Each 'no caller/not found' claim was produced by a search that also matched a known positive case in the same run (e.g. SecurityHelper.isUserInRole found in SecurityConstraint while SecurityConfiguration.isAuthorized had no caller; xref.js positive controls EditObjectAction / struts Action / projects.jsp; jrxml search control JRXmlLoader).

items.title: Legacy package composition
items.detail: legacy/ contains xplanner-plus.war (29,727,650 bytes), docker-compose.yml, README.md, demo-seed.sql. WAR: 1090 entries, 964 files: 594 classes, 27 xml + 23 properties + 3 vm under WEB-INF/classes, 102 jars, 73 JSP (+1 .tag), 26 WEB-INF descriptors/TLDs, static ui/js/css/images/calendar/flash/files, root activity log.

items.title: Product identity and version
items.detail: XPlanner+ version 1.1a4, build date 04/12/2011, revision 426; Maven artifact net.sf:xplanner-plus:1.1 built 2011-12-04 with JDK 1.6.0_29; Struts 1.2.9 + Spring 3.0.5 + Hibernate 3.6.5 + Servlet 2.4 web-app.

items.title: Local run helper (packaging context)
items.detail: docker-compose runs mysql:5.7 (db xplanner, user xplanner/xplanner, root/root) and tomcat:9.0-jre8 on 8080 with the WAR mounted as xplanner-legacy.war (context /xplanner-legacy per its comment), CATALINA_OPTS -Xms256m -Xmx768m -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -Xverify:none. README (Russian) states context /xplanner-plus and default login sysadmin/admin, and says the WAR's xplanner-custom.properties was patched to MySQL; the compose comment instead names xplanner.properties. Not behaviour evidence.
items.limit: README and compose disagree on context path and on which properties file was patched.

items.title: Known MySQL configuration patch in the baseline
items.detail: Both xplanner.properties (MySQL block active, HSQLDB block commented) and xplanner-custom.properties (under a comment 'embedded persistent HSQLDB' but setting MySQL jdbc:mysql://db/xplanner, user/password xplanner) point to MySQL host 'db'. spring-beans.xml dataSource sets defaultAutoCommit=false with a comment explaining a MySQL commit/rollback fix. These are treated as the fixed baseline, not as unmodified upstream delivery.
items.limit: Which exact lines were changed from upstream cannot be determined from the WAR alone.

items.title: demo-seed.sql is a prepared fixture
items.detail: Header comments describe a demo rebuild of 'Acme Web Store' mirroring 'the new app', creation of person 'alex', and wiping of projects and child rows; classified as fixture only, not used as behaviour evidence.

items.title: Container-specific descriptors and assumed context paths
items.detail: META-INF/context.xml path=/xplanner-plus; sun-web.xml context-root /xplanner-plus (keepgenerated JSP); geronimo-web.xml context-root /xplanner. Hard-coded '/xplanner/...' links in all WAP JSPs and in the formatting-help link.

items.title: Shipped runtime artefact: activity log in WAR root
items.detail: xplanner-plus-activity.log (26,728 bytes) is packaged at the WAR root and contains activity lines (timestamp, user id, client IP, action, query string) from a 12/03 session. Because log4j writes ACTIVITY_FILE to ${xplanner-plus.root}/xplanner-plus-activity.log (webapp root) and no filter/constraint covers that path, the live activity log is inferred to be downloadable as a static file.

items.title: Web HTML channel (Struts 1.2, /do/*)
items.detail: XPlannerServlet (net.sf.xplanner.struts.XPlannerActionServlet, load-on-startup 2, validate=true) mapped to /do/*; config = struts-config.xml + mobile-struts-config.xml + test-struts-config.xml merged into one default module: 87 action mappings (74 main, 7 mobile, 6 test). Exhaustive list with form, input, forwards, exceptions, Spring bean class and security classification in the breakdown.

items.title: Mobile WAP/WML channel (/do/mobile/*)
items.detail: 7 mappings (login + 6 read-only views of projects/project/iteration/story/task/person) rendering text/vnd.wap.wml JSPs under WEB-INF/jsp/wap; guarded by MobileSecurityFilter; links hard-coded to /xplanner context.

items.title: SOAP channel (Apache Axis 1.4)
items.detail: AxisServlet mapped to /soap/* and /servlet/AxisServlet; server-config.wsdd deploys service 'XPlanner' (java:RPC, class com.technoetic.xplanner.soap.XPlanner, allowedMethods=*) with 43 public operations, and 'Version' (getVersion). Global config: adminPassword=admin, attachments directory C:\projects\xplanner-soap\..., JWSHandler in request flow (no .jws files shipped), HTTPAuthHandler. BasicSecurityFilter covers /soap/* only, not /servlet/AxisServlet.

items.title: REST channel (Jersey 1.x on Spring, /rest/*)
items.detail: Jersey SpringServlet (POJO JSON mapping) mapped to /rest/*; resources from component-scan net.sf.xplanner.rest: GET /rest/view (text 'Hi there!'), GET /rest/view/project/{projectId} (XML/JSON ProjectView), GET /rest/view/iteration/{iterationId}/userstories (XML/JSON UserStoryView[] with tasks), POST /rest/update/task/{taskId}/status (form params status, originalEstimate). No security filter is mapped to /rest/*.

items.title: iCalendar channel (/ical/*)
items.detail: iCalServlet mapped to /ical/*, protected by BasicSecurityFilter; serves <userId>.ics calendars (see A-095).

items.title: Spring MVC channel (/setting/*)
items.detail: DispatcherServlet (spring-web.xml, load-on-startup 1) mapped to /setting/*, protected by WebSecurityFilter; controllers from component-scan net.sf.xplanner.web: MePage GET /setting/me/status/{id} -> view view/meStatus (JstlView prefix /WEB-INF/jsp/); CommonObjectHandler /setting/{objectType}/list and /setting/{objectType}/edit/{objectId} only print to stdout.

items.title: Chart image channel (/cewolf/*)
items.detail: Cewolf CewolfRenderer (load-on-startup 1, overlib ../../../overlib.js, debug false) mapped to /cewolf/*; renders JFreeChart images produced by cewolf tags in iterationStatistics, timesheet and aggregateTimesheet JSPs. No security filter mapped.

items.title: Static resources and welcome file
items.detail: Welcome file index.jsp (not covered by a security filter mapping); static css, js (jQuery 1.5.1, jQuery UI 1.8.11, dojo, jqote2, overlib, nifty, swfobject, calendar), images, flash/Dashboard.swf and expressInstall.swf (no referencing page found), files/peopleImportTemplate.xls and files/storiesImportTemplate.xls (download links via message keys), js/chart.html, calendar/cal.html, WEB-INF/jsp/common/dragdrop.html (not directly servable).

items.title: Disabled or unwired channels
items.detail: JAX-WS WSServlet /service/* and WSServletContextListener are commented out; sun-jaxws.xml names implementation net.sf.xplanner.soap.XPlanner which is absent from the WAR; XFire Spring config commented out; DWR class net.sf.xplanner.dwr.Project exists without a DWR servlet, dwr.xml or dwr jar; NullSecurityFilter commented out.

items.title: Servlet filter chain
items.detail: Mappings in declaration order: ActivityLogFilter /do/*; ServletRequestFilter /* (thread-local request, attributes currentPageUrl/appPath); Spring OpenSessionInViewFilter /* (REQUEST, ERROR); HibernateSessionFilter /* (binds Spring session to ThreadSession and request attribute); MobileSecurityFilter /do/mobile/*; WebSecurityFilter (FormSecurityFilter, /WEB-INF/security.xml, authenticatorUrl /do/login) /do/* and /setting/*; BasicSecurityFilter (/WEB-INF/soap-security.xml) /soap/* and /ical/*; RequestCharacterEncodingFilter UTF-8 /do/* (mapped after the security filters).

items.title: Context listeners and startup hooks
items.detail: Log4jConfigListener (classpath:log4j-war.xml, webAppRootKey xplanner-plus.root); HsqldbServerContextListener starts an in-process HSQLDB server only when xplanner.migration.databasetype=hsqldb (shipped value mysql, so not started); Spring ContextLoaderListener (classpath:spring-beans.xml); RequestContextListener; net.sf.xplanner.context.ContextLoaderListener puts iterationTypes (REGULAR, BACKLOG) and appUrl (=xplanner.application.url) into the ServletContext; SystemInfo logs an 'XPLANNER INFO' block at startup.

items.title: Struts-to-Spring action wiring
items.detail: Controller processorClass DelegatingTilesRequestProcessor resolves each action path to a Spring bean of the same name; ContextLoaderPlugIn builds that context from action-servlet.xml, classes/spring-beans.xml and test-action-servlet.xml (default-autowire byName, lazy-init). TilesPlugin loads tiles-definitions.xml only. Because spring-beans.xml is loaded again in the plug-in context, its non-lazy singletons (liquibase, scheduler, scheduled tasks, authorizerInitializer) are inferred to be instantiated a second time.
items.limit: Duplicate instantiation is an inference from Spring semantics; not observed.

items.title: Spring root context composition
items.detail: spring-beans.xml imports spring-caching.xml, spring-dao.xml, spring-security.xml; defines properties (XPlannerProperties), PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer, messageSource (classpath:ResourceBundle, UTF-8), strutsMessageSource, persistence beans, repositories, domain helpers, import/export beans, email beans, data sampling, scheduling, eventBus (EventManager), daoScanner (prints DAO beans), Jackson provider.

items.title: Property loading and effective overrides
items.detail: XPlannerProperties loads classpath xplanner.properties, then overlays the file named by system property xplanner.overrides (default xplanner-custom.properties). Effective overrides: hibernate MySQL settings, hibernate.show_sql=false, xplanner.application.url=http://localhost:8080/xplanner, login.instructions.url=http://xplanner-plus.sourceforge.net/documentation/. Seven other shipped files (xplanner-custom-apdbuild3/-apdbuild6/-before-standalone-install-backup/-production/-standalone-install/-template/-war-install.properties) are not loaded unless the system property selects one. EditPropertiesAction can change the in-memory properties at runtime (A-057).

items.title: Effective configuration values and their consumers
items.detail: Consumers found: chart flags burndown/progress=displayed, velocity=notDisplayed, width 800, height 400, include.weekends=true (iterationStatistics.jsp); xplanner.statistics=on (iteration globalLinks.jsp statistics link); xplanner.story.defaultpriority=4 (UserStoryEditorForm.resetPriority); xplanner.security.login[0]=XPlannerLoginModule, userIdCaseSensitive=true (LoginModuleLoader, SecurityHelper); search.content.globalScopeEnable=true (ContentSearchAction); iteration.automatically.extend.endDate=false (DataSamplerImpl); xplanner.project.send.notification=true (EditProjectAction default, EmailNotificationSupport); xplanner.mail.smtp.host=localhost, port 25, from xplanner@xplannerplus.org (EmailMessageImpl, EmailNotificationSupport); xplanner.integration.listeners=IntegrationEmailNotifier (IntegrationAction.init); twiki schemes and twiki.wikiadapter=GenericWikiAdapter with topic URLs http://localhost:9090/vqw/jsp/Wiki (TwikiFormat); import.spreadsheet.* header defaults (ImportStoriesAction); support.issue.url/error.filingInfo (unexpectedError.jsp, footer.jsp); hibernate.query.substitutions (UseBeansTag). No consumer found for actionbuttons.* (file comment 'Verify that nobody uses these'), xplanner.export.formats, xplanner.test.*, hibernate.dbcp.*, org.quartz.*.
items.limit: Consumer search is by string constant in bytecode/JSP; reflective or concatenated keys could be missed.

items.title: Hibernate properties do not reach the Spring SessionFactory
items.detail: The sessionFactory bean (AnnotationSessionFactoryBean) sets only dataSource, packagesToScan and mappingLocations; no hibernateProperties, and no hibernate.properties/hibernate.cfg.xml is shipped. hibernate.dialect=XPlannerMySQLDialect, cache provider/query-cache/second-level-cache and query substitutions from xplanner.properties are therefore inferred not to apply to the web SessionFactory (Hibernate would auto-detect the dialect). HibernateHelper builds a separate SessionFactory from XPlannerProperties, used only by standalone tools.

items.title: Internationalisation
items.detail: 11 resource bundles (default, --, da, de, es, fr, it, ja, pt_br, ru) served through Spring ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource (fallbackToSystemLocale=false) bridged to Struts by XPlannerMessageResources; /do/changeLocale?language=..&returnto=.. stores a Locale in the session (no page links to it were found); per-locale date/time formats format.date/format.datetime drive parsing and display.

items.title: Logging and activity audit
items.detail: Root logger INFO to console; ActivityLogFilter logs a START and END line for every /do/* request (time, user id, remote IP, action, duration, query string) to ACTIVITY_FILE (rolling 5MB x 50) and console. FILE appender defined but not referenced. unexpectedError.jsp logs 'JSP error' with the exception.

items.title: Page layout composition (Tiles)
items.detail: Tiles definitions tiles:default, tiles:view, tiles:print (extends view), tiles:edit; ContentTag selects tiles:print when print mode else tiles:default; header with search box, 'Me' link (to ${appUrl}/setting/me/status/{personId}), logout and breadcrumb navigation; footer with version and a system-information link built from appUrl. tiles-pages.xml (viewLayout -> viewLayoutNew.jsp) is loaded only by the Spring MVC TilesConfigurer.

items.title: Permission caching and invalidation
items.detail: Method-result caches (shared HashMap) on AuthorizerQueryHelper.getAllPermissions/getAllPermissionsToPerson and PrincipalSpecificPermissionHelper.getPermissionsForPrincipal; invalidated after Authenticator.logout (for the person argument) and after EditPersonHelper.modifyRoles; manual clear via /do/invalidateCache. Hibernate query cache evicted via /do/invalidateHibernateCache. ehcache.xml present.

items.title: Persistence wiring
items.detail: DBCP BasicDataSource from ${hibernate.connection.*} placeholders with defaultAutoCommit=false; Liquibase bean runs classpath:db-changelog.xml (contexts 'test, production') before the SessionFactory; AnnotationSessionFactoryBean scans net.sf.xplanner.domain (27 annotated classes incl. embeddables/superclasses) plus named queries from mappings/Metrics.xml; HibernateTransactionManager with tx:annotation-driven (@Transactional DAO methods); TransactionTemplate subclass wraps AbstractAction execution; open-session-in-view per request.

items.title: Unloaded legacy mapping files and unmapped classes
items.detail: 16 of 17 files in WEB-INF/classes/mappings (DataSample, Directory, Feature, File, HistoricalEvent, Integration, Iteration, Note, Permission, Person, Project, Role, RoleAssociation, Task, TimeEntry, UserStory) are not referenced by the active configuration; only Metrics.xml is loaded. Consequently com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Integration and com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Feature are not Hibernate entities (only net.sf.xplanner.domain.* are).

items.title: Identifier generation
items.detail: All DomainObject, History, Permission and Role ids use HibernateIdentityGenerator (TableHiLo on table identifier, column nextId, max_lo 10); seeded nextId=19.

items.title: Web form login
items.detail: POST /do/login (DynaActionForm userId, password, action, remember). Without userId the login page is shown. Otherwise Authenticator.authenticate runs the configured login modules in order; on success the JAAS-like Subject (PersonPrincipal) is stored in the HTTP session, credential cookies are set when remember=Y (checked by default on the form), and the user is redirected to the URL saved before login or to /do/view/projects. On failure 'login.failed' plus per-module messages are shown on login.jsp. When login.instructions.url is set (it is, via override) login.jsp shows a help link whose message includes 'Default login and password are: sysadmin/admin'.
items.limit: Exact branch order inside execute inferred from constants and calls.

items.title: XPlanner password login module
items.detail: Looks up Person by userid (HQL), fails with userNotFound / passwordNotSet / authenticationFailed; password stored as Base64(salt + MD5(salt+password)) with random salt; changePassword encodes a new salted hash and commits; logout invalidates the HTTP session.

items.title: Remember-me cookie authentication
items.detail: FormSecurityFilter: when no subject in session but cookies 'userid' and 'password' (password Base64-encoded plain text) exist, it authenticates with them; on failure the cookies are removed and the user is redirected to the login URL (URL saved only for GET requests).

items.title: Logout
items.detail: /do/logout calls Authenticator.logout (login module invalidates session; permission cache entry for the user invalidated), removes credential cookies and forwards to security/login (/do/login).

items.title: URL security constraints enforce authentication only
items.detail: security.xml / mobile-security.xml / soap-security.xml declare constraints and role names, but the filters call only isSecureRequest and isAuthenticated; SecurityConfiguration.isAuthorized (the only role check) has no caller. Therefore every /do/* and /setting/* request except the bypass list (/do/login, /do/notAuthorized, /do/invalidateHibernateCache) needs an authenticated subject, and no URL-level role restriction applies (most role names are commented out and replaced by '*').

items.title: Mobile login reachability
items.detail: MobileSecurityFilter bypasses /do/mobile/login and /do/mobile/notAuthorized, but WebSecurityFilter (/do/*) runs next and its bypass list does not contain /do/mobile/login; an unauthenticated WAP login request is inferred to be redirected to the web /do/login.

items.title: HTTP Basic authentication for SOAP and iCal
items.detail: BasicSecurityFilter reuses a session subject or decodes the Authorization: Basic header and authenticates through the same Authenticator; on failure responds with WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="XPlanner" and an error status.

items.title: Optional login modules (not configured)
items.detail: JNDI/LDAP (com.sabre JNDIAuthenticatorImpl; options connectionURL, userPattern, roleBase ...), NTLM via jcifs (options domain, controller; hard-coded default domain 'YANDEX'), and a JAAS adapter are packaged and registered as prototype beans; only XPlannerLoginModule is configured (login[1], login[2] commented). JNDI/NTLM/JAAS modules do not support password change.

items.title: Role model
items.detail: Roles viewer(id 2, lft 1, rgt 8), editor(3, 2-7), admin(4, 3-6), sysadmin(5, 4-5) stored as a nested set in table roles; person_role(role_id, person_id, project_id) where project_id 0 means all projects; seeded person 1 'sysadmin' (userId sysadmin, email no@reply.com, initials SYS, salted password hash) with role sysadmin on project 0. Effective role per project resolved by named query security.roles (includes wildcard project).

items.title: Permission model and seeded permissions
items.detail: permission(principal, name pattern, resource_type pattern, resource_id, positive). Seeded: sysadmin %/% positive; editor create.project/system.project NEGATIVE, create.person/system.person NEGATIVE, create%, edit%, integrate%, delete% positive, delete/system.project.iteration NEGATIVE; admin create.project NEGATIVE, admin% positive; viewer read% positive. Positive permissions of weaker roles are inherited through the nested set; negative permissions apply only to the exact role. Resource types map classes: system.project, .iteration, .story, .task, .feature, .time_entry, system.project.integration, system.person, system.note, system.setting. Person-specific permissions (resource_type system.person, principal = person id) are also read.

items.title: Where authorization is enforced server-side
items.detail: Authorizer.hasPermission is called only in: EditRoleAction (admin.edit.role on project), EditPersonHelper (admin.edit.role per project when changing roles), SOAP XPlanner (read/edit/create/delete per object), iCalServlet (other user's calendar), content search result filter (read), AggregateTimesheetQuery (read per project), RepositorySecurityAdapter (only for repositories obtained from metaRepository), Iteration/UserStory repositories (edit filter for selection lists), PermissionHelper, DispatchForward (only when an '@secure' forward exists; none is configured) and JSP tags. The generic Struts ViewObjectAction, EditObjectAction (and subclasses), DeleteObjectAction, ExportAction, FileManagerAction, UpdateTimeAction, Move/Continue actions and the test/admin actions contain no authorization call; access control for them is inferred to be UI-only (links hidden by isUserAuthorized tags).
evidence: Grep CALL .../Authorizer.hasPermission over classdump (20 files, positive matches)
items.limit: Bytecode was not decompiled; absence of an Authorizer call in these classes is mechanical, the resulting runtime access is not observed.

items.title: UI permission gating (tags and domain action metadata)
items.detail: DomainMetaDataRepository defines object actions with permissions and icons: project edit (admin.edit) and delete (sysadmin.delete, confirmation); iteration edit, delete, createStory, start (visible when not active), close (visible when active), importStories; story edit, delete, movecontinue; task edit, delete, movecontinue, edittime; person edit. JSPs additionally gate: create.project, create.person, admin.hide (see hidden people), hide (hidden flag), admin.edit.role, sysadmin.promote, integrate, read on system.person, edit on notes/features/tasks, edit on iteration for reordering.

items.title: Endpoints reachable without authentication
items.detail: /do/login, /do/notAuthorized, /do/invalidateHibernateCache (evicts Hibernate query cache), all /rest/* (read and task-status update), /cewolf/*, /servlet/AxisServlet (not covered by BasicSecurityFilter; XPlanner operations are inferred to fail their permission checks without a subject, but the Axis service/WSDL listing is served), /index.jsp (runs a project query and redirects), static files including the activity log.

items.title: Session handling
items.detail: Session timeout 30 minutes; Subject stored in session attribute SECURITY_SUBJECT, LoginContext in LOGIN_CONTEXT, saved pre-login URL in SAVED_URL, Struts locale in session; web-app marked distributable.

items.title: Error handling paths
items.detail: Struts global exceptions: repository ObjectNotFoundException and Hibernate UnresolvableObjectException -> generalError.jsp (error.objectNotFound); AuthorizationException -> generalError.jsp (security.notauthorized); edit/person DuplicateUserIdException -> editPerson.jsp (person.editor.userid_exist); import/stories importer exceptions -> stories.jsp messages. Container error pages for JspException, ServletException and Throwable -> unexpectedError.jsp which shows the first 3 lines of the message, filing instructions, full exception and stack trace, build/database (password masked '******')/app server/memory/system properties, request URL parts, all request parameters and attributes, and logs the error.

items.title: System information page
items.detail: /do/systemInfo (authenticated) sets isSystemInfo and forwards to unexpectedError.jsp in system-info mode (environment sections without an exception). Footer message links to appUrl + '/do/systemInfo'.

items.title: Not-authorized path is broken
items.detail: Global forward security/notAuthorized points to /WEB-INF/jsp/security/notAuthorized.jsp, which is not in the WAR; DispatchForward and ImportPeopleAction use this forward, so their unauthorized branch is inferred to end in a missing-resource error.

items.title: Test and administration actions active in the production module
items.detail: Loaded via test-struts-config.xml/test-action-servlet.xml into the same module, authentication only: /do/edit/dataSample (runs data sampling now), /do/edit/missingTimeEntryNotification (sends missing-time-entry emails now), /do/edit/putTheClockForward?dayOffset=N (moves the application clock TimeGenerator by N days; without a valid offset resets), /do/edit/properties?propertyName=&propertyValue= (sets an in-memory XPlanner property), /do/invalidateCache (clears permission cache), /do/invalidateHibernateCache (security bypass; evictQueries), /do/admin/reload-tiles (Tiles ReloadDefinitionsAction). All return to 'returnto' or view/projects; invalidateCache.jsp input is missing.

items.title: Home redirect (index.jsp)
items.detail: Counts visible (hidden=false) projects: 0 or more than 1 -> redirect /do/view/projects; exactly 1 -> redirect to its current iteration (/do/view/iteration?oid=) when one covers today, else /do/view/projects.

items.title: Projects list
items.detail: /do/view/projects (DispatchForward, authorizationRequired=false) -> projects.jsp: table of projects with current iteration link and per-project action buttons (edit admin.edit, delete sysadmin.delete); hidden projects visible to users allowed 'hide'; 'add project' link when create.project; links to people and aggregate timesheet; empty-state message.
items.limit: Exact hidden-project where clause not captured by the extractor.

items.title: Create or update project
items.detail: /do/edit/project with ProjectEditorForm (name required: project.editor.missing_name; description; hidden (shown with 'hide' permission); optEscapeBrackets; sendemail; wiki URL). Create/Update via CommonDao; project attributes twiki.scheme.wiki, xplanner.project.send.notification and xplanner.escape.brackets are saved in table attribute; create/update events published; returns to 'returnto' or view/projects. Unknown action -> ServletException.

items.title: Maintain missing-time-entry notification receivers
items.detail: On the project editor, action addTimeNotification / delTimeNotification forwards to /do/edit/project/notification (UpdateTimeNotificationReceivers) which adds or removes a Person in project.notificationReceivers (join table notification_receivers); validation skipped for these actions.

items.title: Delete project
items.detail: /do/delete/project?oid (DeleteObjectAction): loads project, publishes delete event, CommonDao.delete; JPA cascade ALL to iterations, then REMOVE to stories, tasks and time entries; notes, history, attributes, person_role rows, data samples are not cascaded. FK notification_receivers.project_id (NO ACTION) is inferred to make deletion fail while receivers exist. Redirect to returnto or view/projects.

items.title: View project
items.detail: /do/view/project?oid (ViewObjectAction type Project) -> project.jsp: description (wiki formatted), iterations table with action buttons by permission, 'create iteration' (create on system.project.iteration), people link (read system.person), export links, history link, notes panel.

items.title: Exports
items.detail: ExportAction loads object by oid and streams exporter output with its headers: xml (Betwixt XML of projects/iterations/stories/tasks/time entries/people with password hidden; text/xml export.xml) for project and iteration; mpx (application/mpx export.mpx, MPXJ) and mspdi (application/mspdi export.xml) for project and iteration; pdf story/task cards (iText, application/pdf export.pdf) for iteration, story, task; jrpdf JasperReports (report.pdf) for iteration, story, task, person. Export errors roll back and raise ExportException.

items.title: Create or edit iteration
items.detail: /do/edit/iteration (IterationEditorForm): name required; start/end dates must parse (format.date) and end must follow start (iteration.editor.nonpositive_interval); days worked; description. On Create the iteration is linked to projectId, set INACTIVE and daysWorked initialised.

items.title: View iteration (stories)
items.detail: /do/view/iteration?oid -> iteration.jsp: iteration header (dates, hours estimated/actual/remaining, progress) and story table (order no, priority, customer, tracker, estimates, progress), per-story action buttons, 'save order' and 'move multiple' controls for users with edit on the iteration; empty-state 'stories.none'.

items.title: Start iteration
items.detail: /do/start/iteration: shows confirmation (editIterationStatus.jsp) with count of already started iterations and option to close them; on confirm Iteration.start() (stories and tasks record original estimates), opening data samples generated, history 'started' saved, optional closing of other started iterations; when entered from time entry (wizard), returns to /do/edit/time with the saved time form.

items.title: Close iteration
items.detail: /do/close/iteration: when active, sets INACTIVE, generates closing data samples (end date or today), saves history 'closed', then redirects (onclose) to /do/continue/unfinished/stories for the iteration.

items.title: Continue unfinished stories
items.detail: /do/continue/unfinished/stories: choose a target iteration (future iterations of the project; message when none); Ok with the same iteration -> iteration.status.editor.continue_in_same_iteration; on Ok the source iteration is set inactive and each incomplete story is continued into the target (clone with remaining hours, carried-over disposition, tasks and notes copied, description cross-links, history 'continued'); Cancel returns.

items.title: Reorder stories
items.detail: /do/edit/reorderstories (storyIds[], orderNos[]; invalid number -> story.editor.invalid.order.number) applies Iteration.modifyStoryOrder and redirects to /do/view/iteration?oid.

items.title: Move several stories to another iteration
items.detail: /do/move/userstories (selected story ids, target iteration) moves each story (UserStory.moveTo: started and disposition added when target active), records history 'moved out'/'moved in', reorders, redirects to the source iteration.

items.title: Delete iteration
items.detail: /do/delete/iteration?oid (form-bean name iterationEditorForm is undefined): delete event then delete with cascade REMOVE to stories, tasks, time entries; FK story.iteration_id etc. satisfied by cascade; notes/history/data samples orphaned. Editor role has a negative 'delete' permission on iterations (enforced in UI only).

items.title: Iteration analysis views
items.detail: Tasks (/view/iteration/tasks: all tasks with acceptor, status legend started/completed/unassigned/unestimated, action buttons); Features (/view/iteration/features); Metrics (/view/iteration/metrics: IterationMetrics per developer total/paired/unpaired hours, accepted hours, remaining); Statistics (/view/iteration/statistics: pie charts of task count, estimated and actual hours by type and by disposition, velocity line chart hidden by config, progress and burndown line charts from data samples; link shown only when xplanner.statistics=on); Accuracy (/view/iteration/accuracy: current status and summary of original vs current estimates, added, postponed, over/under-estimated); Dashboard (/view/dashboard?fkey=iterationId: 3-column not started / in progress / done board filled from GET /rest/view/iteration/{id}/userstories, drag and drop is client-side only, nothing saved); History.

items.title: Import stories from spreadsheet
items.detail: /do/import/stories?oid=iteration (multipart ImportStoriesForm): Excel (POI HSSF) worksheet name and column headers (title, end date, estimate, priority, status, completed status value) default from properties, remembered in cookies; option onlyIncomplete; missing file/headers/worksheet validations; creates stories in the iteration and lists imported stories; importer errors shown as corrupted_file / missing_required_field / wrong_header / worksheet_not_found messages. Download template files/storiesImportTemplate.xls.

items.title: Create or edit story
items.detail: /do/edit/userstory (UserStoryEditorForm): name required; estimated hours >= 0; priority numeric (default 4); fields disposition, customer, tracker, status (draft/defined/estimated/planned/implemented/verified/accepted), order; description with formatting help. On commit the story is attached to the iteration and story order renumbered; new story disposition planned or added depending on iteration active.

items.title: View story
items.detail: /do/view/userstory?oid -> userstory.jsp: estimate/actual/remaining hours, customer, tracker, last update, disposition, status, tasks table with action buttons, 'create task', story actions (edit/delete/move-continue), export links, notes, history.

items.title: Move or continue story
items.detail: /do/move/continue/userstory: Move -> story moved to target iteration (started and disposition added if target active), history moved out/in; Continue -> story cloned into target with remaining hours (postponed on source), tasks continued; validation: missing name, same iteration; stories in a future iteration can only be moved; source iteration stories reordered.

items.title: Delete story
items.detail: /do/delete/userstory?oid (undefined form-bean userStoryEditorForm): delete event, cascade REMOVE tasks and time entries; notes and history not cascaded.

items.title: Create or edit task
items.detail: /do/edit/task (TaskEditorForm): name required; created date must parse; estimated hours >= 0 (unless merge); fields type (feature, debt, defect, ftest, atest, overhead), disposition, acceptor, completed, description. New task disposition from iteration state. After a successful redirect an HTML email (Velocity email_notification_task_created/updated.vm, subjects 'Task was created.'/'Task was updated.') is compiled with task, assignee, old assignee and creator and sent through EmailNotificationSupport; recipient selection compares acceptor with the current user (exact rule inferred).

items.title: Complete or reopen task
items.detail: On task.jsp, users with edit see a Complete (completed=true) or Reopen (completed=false) button that POSTs to /do/edit/task with action=Update, merge=true, returnto the task page.

items.title: View task
items.detail: /do/view/task?oid -> task.jsp: acceptor, estimates (original when > 0), created date, actual hours, time entry table (start, end, report date, duration, pair, description), simplified inline time entry for the acceptor, task actions, export links, notes, history. The time entry list is loaded by db:useBeans with a where string concatenated from request parameter oid.

items.title: Move or continue task
items.detail: /do/move/continue/task (session-scoped form): target stories are stories of current or future iterations of visible projects where the user has edit (excluding the current story); Move -> task reassigned to target story, disposition follows target iteration, history 'moved'/'moved out'/'moved in' with messages; Continue -> TaskContinuer clones the task with remaining hours into the target and postpones the original; same story -> task.editor.same_story.

items.title: Delete task
items.detail: /do/delete/task?oid: delete event, cascade REMOVE time entries.

items.title: Enter and edit time
items.detail: /do/edit/time?oid=task (TimeEditorForm rows): each row either start+end time (datetime format) or duration, report date required, person1 required, person2 optional and different, no overlapping intervals for the same people, not both interval and duration, end after start, description <= 500 chars; rows can be deleted; remaining hours updated; first effort starts the task; if the iteration is not started the form is saved in session and the user is sent through /do/start/iteration, then returned. UPDATE_ESTIMATE re-estimates the task and saves history 'reestimated' ('Estimate changed from x to y'). Errors return to the editor.

items.title: Personal timesheet
items.detail: /do/view/timesheet (PersonTimesheetForm: person oid, start/end date, default current week, unparsable date -> timesheet.error.unparsable_date): native SQL totals per project/iteration/story and daily totals (entries with report date and no start time, or start time in range), pie charts by project/iteration/story.

items.title: Aggregate timesheet
items.detail: /do/view/aggregateTimesheet (AggregateTimesheetForm: selected people among non-hidden persons, date range default current week): HQL sum of time-entry duration per project/iteration/story, rows limited to projects the user can read, charts by project/iteration/story.

items.title: iCalendar feed
items.detail: GET /ical/<userId>.ics (Basic auth): missing name -> 'No iCal file requested.', missing .ics -> 'No .ics suffix...'; another user's calendar requires admin.edit on system.person for some project, else error 'No authorization for accessing calendar for ...'; output VCALENDAR 1.0 with VTODO for each uncompleted, non-overhead task accepted by the user (summary, category story/iteration/project, percent complete, priority, URL) and VEVENT per time entry of the user (start/end, URL); content type application/x-msoutlook, inline filename.

items.title: People list
items.detail: /do/view/people -> people.jsp: persons ordered by hidden flag and name when the user has admin.hide on system.person, otherwise only non-hidden; optional project context; per-person action buttons; 'add person' when create.person; 'import people'.

items.title: Create or edit person, roles and password
items.detail: /do/edit/person (PersonEditorForm): name, user id, email and initials required; password and confirmation must match; hidden flag (hide permission); per-project role none/viewer/editor/admin (only for projects where the editor has admin.edit.role); sysadmin checkbox (sysadmin.promote). Save via CommonDao (DuplicateUserIdException -> person.editor.userid_exist); roles rewritten through EditPersonHelper.modifyRoles (permission caches invalidated); after commit a non-empty new password is set via the current login module's changePassword.
items.limit: Whether the sysadmin grant is checked server-side against sysadmin.promote is not visible without decompilation.

items.title: View person and 'Me' status
items.detail: /do/view/person?oid (ViewPersonAction, authorizationRequired=false): current active, pending and completed tasks, future tasks, stories where customer and where tracker, timesheet link, export jrpdf. The same data is shown by Spring MVC /setting/me/status/{id} (meStatus.jsp) linked from the header as 'Me'.

items.title: Delete person
items.detail: /do/delete/person?oid: CommonDao.delete with no cascade; FKs story.customer_id and notification_receivers.person_id (NO ACTION) are inferred to block deletion while referenced; person_role, permission, time_entry person ids, task acceptor ids and history person ids are left dangling (the permission cleanup exists only in PersonHibernateObjectRepository, not used by this action).

items.title: Import people
items.detail: /do/import/people (multipart ImportPeopleForm, no file -> import.status.no_import_file): text file, one person per line 'userId,name,email,initials,phone' (5 columns); per line result success / wrong_entry_format / empty_userId / userId_exists (PersonDao duplicate check); saved in a transaction per line; results table. Downloadable template files/peopleImportTemplate.xls.

items.title: Edit project roles
items.detail: /do/edit/roles?oid=project (session-scoped RoleEditorForm): for each non-hidden person choose none/viewer/editor/admin; server checks admin.edit.role on the project; existing person_role rows for the project are deleted and new ones inserted.

items.title: Create or edit note with attachment
items.detail: /do/edit/note (multipart NoteEditorForm): subject, author and body required; attachedToId links the note to a project, iteration, story or task; an uploaded file is stored as xfile BLOB in the virtual file system directory /attachments/project/<projectId>.

items.title: Notes panel, delete note, download attachment
items.detail: notes.jsp on object pages lists attached notes (subject, author, date, attachment), with create/edit/delete when the user has edit. /do/delete/note deletes the note and its file when no other note references it. /do/download/attachment?oid streams the BLOB with the stored content type and Content-disposition note;filename="...".

items.title: File manager
items.detail: /do/view/directory?action=list|upload|download|delete|mkdir|rmdir (FileManagerForm, multipart) operates on xdir/xfile from the root directory; no permission check; unknown directory -> error/objectNotFound; errors roll back.

items.title: Continuous-integration queue
items.detail: /do/view/integrations?projectId and /do/edit/integrations: join queue (person required: integrations.error.noperson; starts immediately when idle), leave, start (error when one is already active), finish, cancel; states P/A/F/X; IntegrationEmailNotifier sends an email to the next person unless nonotify. The code uses com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Integration, which is not a mapped entity (A-032), so persistence and queries are expected to fail.

items.title: Search by id
items.detail: /do/search/id?searchedId: missing -> idsearch.error.missingId, non-numeric -> badId, unknown -> idNotFound (general error); otherwise redirect to /do/view/<type>?oid= (a note resolves to its parent).

items.title: Content search
items.detail: /do/search/content?searchedContent[&restrictToProjectId] from the header box: empty -> 'missing content' error; searches name/description of projects, iterations, stories, tasks and subject/body of notes by LIKE named queries (restricted variants when a project is given or global scope disabled); results filtered by 'read' permission; searchResults.jsp with match excerpts.

items.title: Object history
items.detail: /do/view/history?oid: events of the object and created/deleted events of contained objects with actor and description; 'updated' events are throttled against the latest event. Writers found: start/close iteration, continue (story/task), move (story/task), re-estimate, SOAP operations, and the history adapter used only through metaRepository. The web create/update/delete actions publish Spring events (EventManager) but no listener bean is registered (EmailPerChangeListener is not a bean), so web edits are inferred not to write created/updated/deleted history.

items.title: Settings
items.detail: /do/view/settings lists Setting entities (name, category, default, scope Global/Project/Group/User, object type) with 'add setting' when create.project; /do/edit/setting uses EditObjectAction for Setting with ProjectEditorForm and input editSetting.jsp, which is missing.

items.title: Features
items.detail: View/edit/delete feature actions and feature lists on story/iteration/project pages refer to type net.sf.xplanner.domain.Feature (absent) and com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Feature (unmapped); feature pages and actions are expected to fail; UserStory.getFeatures is transient.

items.title: Wiki-style text formatting
items.detail: Descriptions are rendered by TwikiFormat: headings, lists, tables, verbatim/pre, URLs and images, e-mail links, HTML escaping (per-project attribute xplanner.escape.brackets), scheme links project:/iteration:/story:/task: to /do/view/<type>?oid and configured external schemes, WikiWords through GenericWikiAdapter which opens the configured wiki topic URL to decide existing vs new topic. Formatting help page /do/view/twikiformat.

items.title: Header, breadcrumb and navigation
items.detail: Header shows the authenticated user, 'Me' link, logout and content search; NavigationBarTag builds a breadcrumb project > iteration > story > task (or feature) from oid/fkey with a back link; iteration pages show global links (dashboard, all tasks, metrics, statistics, accuracy, history) and export links.

items.title: Mobile login and read-only views
items.detail: WML login card posts userId/password/remember to /xplanner/do/mobile/login (AuthenticationAction, success -> /do/mobile/view/projects); views list visible projects, a project with its current and other iterations, an iteration's stories, a story's tasks, a task with acceptor, and a person with phone/email; no edit functions.

items.title: Unreferenced debug page wap/auth.jsp
items.detail: Echoes the first cookie name and the userId and password request parameters and sets cookie steve=bate; no mapping or forward references it and it is under WEB-INF, so it is not reachable.

items.title: SOAP API operations
items.detail: 43 public operations: get/add/update/remove for Project, Iteration, UserStory, Task, TimeEntry, Note, Person; list operations getProjects, getIterations(project), getUserStories(iteration), getTasks(story), getTimeEntries(task), getNotesForObject, getPeople; getCurrentIteration(project), getCurrentTasksForPerson, getPlannedTasksForPerson; attribute operations setAttribute/getAttribute/deleteAttribute/getAttributes/getAttributesWithPrefix. Each get checks 'read', update 'edit', add 'create', remove 'delete' for the caller on the object's project (AuthenticationException otherwise); lists return only readable objects; writes save history (created/updated/deleted) and commit, rolling back on error. getCurrentIteration's HQL uses object.projectId, which is not a mapped Iteration property (expected failure).

items.title: REST read API
items.detail: GET /rest/view/project/{id} returns ProjectView (id, name via projection) as XML or JSON; GET /rest/view/iteration/{id}/userstories returns stories (priority, id, name, description, trackerId, estimatedHours, orderNo, status) with tasks (name, id, completed, description, createdDate, originalEstimate, estimatedHours, acceptorId); GET /rest/view returns 'Hi there!'. No authentication or authorization.

items.title: REST task status update
items.detail: POST /rest/update/task/{taskId}/status (status, originalEstimate): unknown task -> 'Task not found'; same status -> 'Task status not changed'; to notStarted -> 'Moving Task to not started not implemented'; to started -> original estimate set and completed=false; to completed -> completed=true; saved; returns Result (success flag, code, message) as XML/JSON. No authentication.
items.limit: Mapping of the two setCompleted calls to branches inferred.

items.title: Missing time entry notification job
items.detail: Spring task:scheduler (pool 10) runs missingTimeEntryNotifier.execute on cron '0 5 0 * * *' (daily 00:05): for tasks of active iterations that are not completed and whose latest time entry is older than the computed cut-off, sends one HTML email per acceptor (only for projects where xplanner.project.send.notification is true) and one per project notification receiver (leads), using email_notifications.vm. Also triggered on demand by /do/edit/missingTimeEntryNotification.
items.limit: Cut-off offset and duplicate scheduling (A-022) not verified; EmailMessageImpl reads ThreadSession, which has no request-bound session in the scheduler thread (possible failure, inferred).

items.title: Data sampling job is defined but not scheduled
items.detail: Quartz JobDetailBean datasamplingJob and CronTriggerBean (0 55 23 ? 1-12 *) exist, but the Quartz SchedulerFactoryBean (and the emailnotification trigger) is commented out, so nightly sampling is inferred not to run. Samples (estimatedHours, actualHours, remainingHours per iteration and day) are written on iteration start/close and by /do/edit/dataSample; optional automatic end-date extension is off.

items.title: Database migration at application startup
items.detail: Liquibase applies db-changelog.xml on context start: changesets 1-1 (create 20 tables if attribute table absent), 1-2 (keys, indexes, 10 foreign keys), 1-3 (seed permissions, roles, patches level 14, identifier 19, sysadmin user and role), 2-1 (object_type, setting tables), 2-2 (7 object types), 2-3 (last_update columns on xdir/xfile), 2-4 (project.backlog_id), 2-5 (rename role -> roles). Normal startup therefore creates and seeds schema.

items.title: Standalone tools packaged in the WAR
items.detail: Classes with main(): BootstrapSystemUser (create sysadmin, roles and permissions; also a tacitknowledge migration task), TomcatUserImporter (import tomcat-users.xml users/roles), XPlannerLoginModule (print encoded 'admin'), IdGenerator, JettyServer (dev server /xplanner), HsqlServer, PdfExporter sample, ProgressBarImage, XPlannerProperties, tacitknowledge StandaloneMigrationLauncher/HsqlAwareStandaloneMigrationLauncher/UpdatePatchLevel/MigrationInformation. None is wired into the web application.

items.title: Database schema and foreign keys
items.detail: Tables: attribute, datasample, history, identifier, integration, iteration, note, notification_receivers, patches, permission, person, person_role, project, roles (renamed from role), story, task, time_entry, xdir, xfile, object_type, setting. Unique: person.userId, roles.role. FKs (all ON DELETE NO ACTION): iteration.project_id->project, note.attachment_id->xfile, notification_receivers.person_id->person and .project_id->project, story.customer_id->person, story.iteration_id->iteration, task.story_id->story, time_entry.task_id->task, xdir.parent_id->xdir, xfile.dir_id->xdir. No FK on note.attachedTo_id, history, attribute.targetId, person_role, permission, time_entry person ids, task.acceptor_id, story.tracker_id, project.backlog_id, setting.objectType_id.

items.title: Entity mapping and cascades
items.detail: 27 annotated classes (21 entities, embeddable ids, mapped superclasses). Cascades: Project.iterations ALL, Project.backlog REMOVE (OneToOne backlog_id, no UI found), Iteration.userStories REMOVE, UserStory.tasks REMOVE, UserStory.customer REFRESH, Task.timeEntries REMOVE (ordered by reportDate). Directory.files/subdirectories, Note.file OneToOne, Project.notificationReceivers ManyToMany plus a separate NotificationReceivers entity on the same table, Project.attributes ElementCollection on table attribute. DomainObject.onUpdate (@PreUpdate) sets last_update.

items.title: Domain enumerations and derived values
items.detail: Iteration status ACTIVE(0)/INACTIVE(1), iteration type REGULAR/BACKLOG; story status draft/defined/estimated/planned/implemented/verified/accepted; story disposition planned/carriedOver/added; task disposition planned/carriedOver/added/discovered/overhead; task types feature/debt/defect/ftest/atest/overhead; setting scope Global/Project/Group/User; integration states P/A/F/X. Iteration and story hour metrics (original, added, postponed, remaining, actual, over/under-estimated) are computed from tasks and time entries; TimeEntry effort doubles when xplanner.pairprogramming='double' (no such property shipped).

items.title: Query and persistence paths
items.detail: Paths: CommonDao (Session get/save/delete/flush/rollback); BaseDao subclasses with @Transactional (Task, UserStory, Project, Person, Role, Setting, ObjectType, Attribute, DataSample, TimeEntry DAOs); ViewDao projections; legacy HibernateObjectRepository/metaRepository (only IntegrationEmailNotifier/emailMessageFactory); HQL strings inside actions, queries, tags and SOAP; 29 named queries in Metrics.xml; native JDBC SQL in PersonTimesheetQuery; JSP db:useBean/db:useBeans tags that run HQL from pages without authorization, including where clauses built from request parameters (task.jsp 'task.id = ' + oid).

items.title: Domain event bus without listeners
items.detail: EditObjectAction and DeleteObjectAction publish ObjectCreated/ObjectUpdated/ObjectDeleted Spring ApplicationEvents via EventManager; EmailPerChangeListener (would email per change) is not declared as a bean and not component-scanned, so the events have no inferred effect.

items.title: Seeded reference data
items.detail: Roles (4), permissions (11), sysadmin person and role assignment, patches row xplanner level 14, identifier nextId 19, object types User, Project, Iteration, UserStory, Task, Note, Setting.

items.title: Relational database
items.detail: MySQL via mysql-connector-java 5.1.13 (driver com.mysql.jdbc.Driver, url jdbc:mysql://db/xplanner, user xplanner); HSQLDB 2.2.4 embedded/in-process server option (disabled by config); Oracle and PostgreSQL blocks commented; p6spy and c3p0 jars shipped but not configured.

items.title: SMTP e-mail
items.detail: JavaMail (mail-1.4.3): mail.smtp.host/port from xplanner.mail.smtp.*, optional user/password enables SMTP auth and STARTTLS; from xplanner.mail.from; HTML bodies from Velocity templates on the classpath; used by task notifications, missing-time-entry job and integration notifier.

items.title: Outbound HTTP calls
items.detail: EmailFormatterImpl fetches ${xplanner.application.url}/css/email.css with HttpClient to inline into emails; GenericWikiAdapter opens the configured wiki topic URL for each WikiWord while rendering text.

items.title: Directory and Windows authentication (optional)
items.detail: LDAP/JNDI, NTLM (jcifs 1.0.1) and JAAS integrations available through login modules; not configured (A-047).

items.title: Library inventory
items.detail: 102 bundled jars (Struts 1.2.9, Spring 3.0.5 modules incl. spring-struts, Hibernate core 3.6.5 + annotations + JPA 2.0 API, Liquibase 2.0.1, Axis 1.4 (+ saaj, jaxrpc, wsdl4j), Jersey 1.1.5/1.5 + Jackson 1.7.4, Quartz 1.5.2, Velocity 1.5 and 1.4-dep, POI 3.5, MPXJ 3.0.1, iText 1.01, JasperReports 1.0.2, Cewolf 1.0 + JFreeChart 1.0.11 + JCommon, Batik, displaytag 1.0, EhCache 1.2.3, commons-* (beanutils in three versions, dbcp, pool, digester, collections, lang, fileupload 1.0, validator), JSTL 1.1.2, log4j 1.2.15, slf4j, radeox, sitemesh (no filter configured), xstream, Jetty 5.1.10/start-6.1.17 (dev launcher), HSQLDB, MySQL driver, c3p0, p6spy, jcifs, mail, activation, proxytoys, oscore, odmg, jdom, dom4j, antlr, asm, cglib, javassist 3.8.0.GA).

items.title: Runtime platform dependencies
items.detail: Servlet 2.4 / JSP container with javax.* APIs (not bundled); charts need a graphics environment (property comment: needs Windows or X server, else disable statistics); JVM compatibility constraints are described only by the local run helper (Java 8, -Xverify:none).

items.title: Missing resources referenced by active configuration
items.detail: Mechanical cross-check (comment-stripped XML): forwards to absent JSPs /WEB-INF/jsp/view/iterationIterations.jsp (global view/iteration/statistics; the action itself uses iterationStatistics.jsp), taskhistory.jsp, viewtext.jsp, /images/calendar.png, security/notAuthorized.jsp, view/iterationTabs.jsp (action /view/iterationTabs), edit/editSetting.jsp, admin/invalidateCache.jsp; absent classes net.sf.xplanner.domain.Feature (3 beans), com.technoetic.xplanner.importer.MissingWorksheetException (struts exception type; real class is in importer.spreadsheet), net.sf.xplanner.soap.XPlanner (disabled JAX-WS); undefined form-beans iterationEditorForm, featureEditorForm, userStoryEditorForm, edit/task/estimate, /download/attachment, edit/properties; /do/edit/task/estimate is a plain org.apache.struts.action.Action; hard-coded /xplanner context links in WAP pages and formatting help.
items.limit: Runtime consequences (404, bean creation errors, ignored form) are inferred.

items.title: JasperReports templates missing
items.detail: PdfReportExporter compiles com/technoetic/xplanner/export/reports/JRIteration.jrxml, JRStory.jrxml, JRTask.jrxml (and a person report); no .jrxml or .jasper resource exists in the WAR or any bundled jar, so all jrpdf exports are expected to fail.
evidence: search of war-entries.txt and all jar listings for 'jrxml' (control: JRXmlLoader found)

items.title: Other code paths expected to fail or be inert
items.detail: Spring MVC CommonObjectHandler list/edit only print and return no explicit view; TaskRepositoryHibernate named-query constants (net.sf.xplanner.domain.TimeEntryEmailNotification...) do not exist in Metrics.xml and getProjectLeadsEmailNotification has no caller; IterationRepository static HQL uses i.projectId (unmapped); SOAP getCurrentIteration uses object.projectId; 'Me' link and email links use xplanner.application.url (override http://localhost:8080/xplanner), which differs from the deployed context paths; DataSample2, *2 domain classes, OLDIdSearchHelper, IOStream are unused legacy code.

exhaustiveBreakdowns.struts-actions.json: all 87 Struts action mappings with form, input, forwards, exceptions, Spring bean class and security classification
exhaustiveBreakdowns.entities.json: 27 annotated persistence classes with table, keys and relationship annotations
exhaustiveBreakdowns.jsp-index.json: 74 JSP/tag files with forms, links, includes, tags, permissions
exhaustiveBreakdowns.jsp-detail.txt: per-JSP inputs, message keys and conditional/authorization lines
exhaustiveBreakdowns.config-xref.json: 433 class references and 120 path references from active XML config with existence result
exhaustiveBreakdowns.tools/: reviewer scripts used to generate the above (read-only over scratch copies)

coverageStatement: Enumerated mechanically: all web.xml elements, all 87 action mappings in the 3 loaded Struts files, all Spring beans in the 7 active Spring XML files, all 3 security configs, the Axis deployment, all 74 JSP/tag files, all 594 classes (parsed), 27 entities, the Liquibase changelog, the loaded named queries, 102 jars and 11 bundles. Read or summarised in depth: all action, form, security, filter, SOAP, REST, web, DAO, repository, mail, chart, export, import, file, history, wiki and db classes. Not individually analysed (only classified): tags/displaytag rendering classes, util/format helpers, third-party classes packaged under WEB-INF/classes (com.thoughtworks.proxy, org.apache.struts.upload, org.displaytag overrides, com.sabre JNDI internals, com.tacitknowledge), static JavaScript/CSS/images, locale-specific message texts beyond key presence.
unresolved: All behaviour is static-only; runtime confirmation belongs to Stage 3.
Branch order and exact conditions inside methods are inferred from string constants and call lists (no decompiler).
Whether sysadmin promotion is checked server-side (A-094), exact email recipient rules (A-084, A-120) and the mobile-login redirect (A-045) are unresolved.
Hidden-project where clause in projects.jsp and JSP HTML details beyond extracted inputs/keys were not read line by line for every page.
